# Channel scoreboard — per-channel, per-work-class track record

Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| Channel | Work class | Attempts | Mean | Recent scores (new→old) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HPSM agent | readiness sprint under the slip (s27) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-18 — five-item queue complete in ~22 min, then STOPPED on the diminishing-returns clause with an honest "next session is thin".** Four papers verified on disk by me (O1 29.7KB · two clinic topology/models papers · post-slip one-pager); board 24→24 with seven reopened-window retitles. **O1 answered by INVERSION: Compliance Manager has no read API — but Secure Score + Defender for Cloud + continuous export are readable at GA and faster than the product itself.** Slip pass found the §7 fixed-calendar schedule expired in the document being signed + the §6 day-for-day trap (HP's P02–P05 overdue; silent rebaseline erases Datasec's relief) + Amplify missed entirely. **Corrected MY brief's "§17 no-rebaseline" to §13 Change Control (verified by my own .docx read — ledger w=14, representations family) and corrected two of its OWN claims on the tickets in the same session.** Zero live API calls, zero Azure writes, nothing HP-facing — the grant held everywhere. The clinic-date framing in its close ("the highest-value thing is not another paper") went to Kam verbatim. |
| Secuura agent | comment-class board leg under a no-merge absolute (s46) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-18 (signing-day morning) — closed 0 / corrected 3 / filed 2 in ~18 minutes, and the zero is the correct number.** All claims verified at source by me before this row: develop unmoved at `74a330fc0` (my ls-remote), board 142→142 on my predicate, KS-660 Blocked with the bot-revert history table in the comment, all four register/correction comments present (20:20–20:21Z). Highlights: **KS-486 turned from a static reading into a RUNTIME proof with a discriminating control** (suspended→401 fires; inactive/deleted PATCH 200 → still ACTIVE → login 200) plus the "adding deactivated is NOT sufficient" trap note; **reported a failed control AS a failed control** (KS-489's second package carried three pins, not the expected one — widened scope instead of quietly confirming); **self-corrected its own pre-push-hook claim in the same wrap** (.git/hooks vs core.hooksPath, "the preflight never executed" over "the push was clean"); refused to manufacture a comment on Peter's KS-662, with the reason stated. Also reconciled my 142 vs its 143 to the row (KS-620's `duplicate` state type — both predicates stated). My own near-miss recorded in the SCORE: my `comments(last:1)` verification query showed three of its four comments absent; the instrument was the defect, full listing found all four — checked my harness before doubting the claim. |
| Secuura agent | boot + triage under an interrupted morning (s39) | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-17 — 20 minutes of reading killed two non-fixes before anyone built them.** Kam launched and wrapped it himself (reboot morning); queue deliberately unstarted. Measured the board before reading my figure (136, predicate stated). Caught that my C-5 row named ONE service where the defect lives in TWO (auth + originate `email.ts`), and that my F-9 row's `:595` uncomment sits in a wholly commented-out block while the LIVE nginx block carries no CSP at all — both rows would have closed tickets while changing nothing. Archived 14 Done with a control proving the zero; extranet left un-marked-seen with the reason stated. Queue re-issued to s40 with its corrections folded in verbatim. |
| NexusAI agent | deploy gate under coordinator silence | 1 | 1.00 | 1.0 | **08-17 — held the authorised RD-95+98 demo deploy because RD-94 is an inseparable git ancestor, and silence may not resolve a scope question permissively.
